Profile.name: Keven Miano
Profile.summary: Software Engineer focused on backend and end-to-end full stack delivery. I work from architecture to cloud operations, building digital products, financial integrations, IoT, and AI-powered solutions — always with measurable business impact.

About.floatCard: Who ships more, shows up more.
About.certified: Backend, cloud, full stack and AI every day

items.quote: Typper MVP that contributed to the acquisition by Árvore. Actively collaborated on Figma AI plugins, which add up to 120k downloads.
Actively collaborated in the integration squad: integrated external ERPs with banking automation, enabling R$25M in CDB operations — supporting the R$45M valuation and the operation's KPIs.
Legacy modernization and refactoring that removed vendor lock-in, cutting operational cost by 30%, with a multi-tenant, event-driven microservices architecture.

highlights: Led the build of a new robust architecture, agnostic to any cloud provider.
Laid the technical foundation to support growth, new customers, and a multi-tenant operation.
Improved product efficiency, security, and stability by prioritizing the main business bottlenecks.
Improved critical post-sale processes to reduce friction in operations and customer support.
Simplified the support and ticket flow, helping deliver a faster response to users.
Supported the evolution of the development process, increasing team predictability and productivity.
Turned a product opportunity into a working MVP that contributed to the acquisition by Árvore.
Built a more agile workflow for designers, reducing manual steps in the creation process.
Helped define the technical and product direction to bring artificial intelligence into the solution.
Helped build the product that took the company to breakeven with R$45M under management.
Developed strategic integrations that expanded the ability to acquire and activate new customers.
Helped enable about R$25M in investment operations, strengthening the platform's value proposition.
Evolved the product architecture to increase reliability and the business's capacity to scale.
Contributed to the evolution of digital financial products during a growth phase of the company.
Supported the development of features focused on operations and the platform's customer experience.
Took part in creating the MVP that supported the product's initial market validation.
Modernized the digital experience to make the customer journey more efficient and improve conversion.
Evolved a legacy system, reducing technical limitations and improving usability.
Supported the technology team in maintaining and evolving internal solutions.
Collaborated on development and support requests that kept day-to-day operations running.
